title: textract.completion.v1
description: SQS message consumed by TextractTaskHandler's COMPLETE_OCR operation (M7, docs/architecture/reviews/m7-extraction-design/claude-reconciliation-final-design.md §1.2/§2). Wraps the raw SNS notification Textract publishes to its job-completion topic when StartDocumentTextDetection's SNS/Role parameters were set. No OCR text/PII ever appears in this envelope - only job identifiers and status, matching design §1.9/§20.5 (OCR content never travels outside the EXTRACTION_TRANSIENT artifact store).

Message.description: JSON-encoded string per AWS SNS convention - Textract's own JobId/Status/JobTag payload, parsed by the handler (not re-validated as nested JSON Schema here, same convention as notification-ses-callback.v1.json's raw SES event body).
